theme_and_archetype.rationale: For a formal, data-dense e-commerce analytics dashboard inspired by Seller Legend, clarity and authority are paramount. The Swiss & High-Contrast approach ensures metrics are the hero, using structural grayscale for hierarchy and strict grid alignment to manage high data density without feeling cluttered.

typography.strategy: The 'Swiss Brutalist' (Tech/Art) - clear, objective, high legibility for data.

fonts.import_instructions: Import both fonts via Google Fonts or Fontshare.

patterns.kpi_row: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 mb-6

rules: Avoid floating cards with heavy drop shadows (no 'Vercel' look).
Use crisp 1px borders (border-[#E5E7EB]) with sharp corners (rounded-none or max rounded-sm).
Widgets sit flush with each other or with tight gaps, forming a continuous dashboard grid.
Hover states on rows/items should use subtle background color shifts (hover:bg-slate-50) rather than lifting with shadows.

buttons.primary: rounded-none bg-[#0055FF] hover:bg-[#0044CC] text-white px-6 py-2.5 text-sm font-medium transition-colors
buttons.secondary: rounded-none border border-[#E5E7EB] bg-white hover:bg-slate-50 text-slate-900 px-6 py-2.5 text-sm font-medium transition-colors

inputs.default: rounded-none border border-[#E5E7EB] bg-white px-4 py-2 text-sm text-slate-900 focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#0055FF] focus:border-[#0055FF]

tables.style: Dense, crisp, border-collapse. Headers are text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 border-b border-[#E5E7EB] bg-slate-50/50. Rows have 1px bottom border. Hover state on rows: bg-slate-50.

charts.style: Minimal axes, solid grid lines (very light gray), no rounded bars. Tooltips must be square, white background, 1px border, no shadow.

icons_and_assets.style: Weight: 'regular' for navigation, 'bold' for active states or tiny indicators. For extreme density, consider 'fill' for micro-charts.

motion.transitions: Fast and crisp. Use duration-150 ease-out for hovers.
motion.loading: Use skeleton loaders matching the exact geometry of the unloaded widget, avoiding generic spinners.

login_background.description: Sleek laptop showcasing data analytics and graphs on the screen in a bright room.

brand_context.description: Interior ambiance setting showcasing context for wall sticker products.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 for standard text (e.g., text-slate-500 on bg-white might need text-slate-600).
accessibility_and_testing.data_testid_rules: ALL interactive elements (buttons, nav links, filters, table rows, file upload zones) MUST have a data-testid attribute formatted as kebab-case, role-based. e.g., 'login-submit-button', 'dashboard-nav-link', 'date-filter-select', 'upload-dropzone', 'export-csv-button'.

Login.layout: Split screen. Left: Branding and Login Form (centered in container, dense inputs). Right: Featured Image (login_background) with black/10 overlay.

Aggregate_Dashboard.layout: Top sticky header (Filters: Date, Currency toggle). F-pattern KPI row (Revenue, Orders, AOV, Margin %). Main body: large Recharts line chart (Sales Trend), Side panel: Donut chart (Marketplace breakdown). Bottom: Heat map calendar (Daily sales).

Marketplace_Breakdown.layout: Tabs for different marketplaces (Amazon, Bol, Kaufland). Grid of comparative metrics and top selling SKUs.

Profit_Loss_Reporting.layout: Financial ledger style. Heavily table-driven with indented rows (Revenue -> COGS -> Amazon Fees -> Shipping -> Net Profit). High contrast positive/negative values.

File_Upload.layout: Central dashboard widget for drag-and-drop. Distinct zones for 'Orders CSV' and 'Cost of Production (SKU) XLSX'. Include upload progress indicators and success/error lists.

instructions_to_main_agent: Do NOT use standard rounded Vercel-like cards. Enforce the Grid Borders technical surface strategy (sharp corners, 1px border, no shadow).
Implement Shadcn components but override their border-radius and shadow utilities globally or per-component.
Use Recharts for the Analytics visuals. Include a Heat Map visualization specifically (using grids or specialized chart).
Data density is key. Use tight line heights for numbers and utilize the IBM Plex Sans font for tabular numbers.
Implement file upload UI using react-dropzone or standard input elements customized heavily.
Strictly apply data-testid on all elements.
